title: A classification of finite simply reducible groups of order at most 2000
summary: We give a computer-assisted classification, up to isomorphism, of all nontrivial finite simply reducible groups of order at most 2000. There are 7889 such groups, all of even order. We provide representatives and a table of their numbers at each order. Order 1024, which is not available as a catalogue of group objects in the SmallGroups library of the computer algebra system GAP, requires a separate construction. Combining descendant generation with a classification of quadratic maps over $\mathbb F_2$, we obtain exactly 803 groups of this order, including 221 of nilpotency class two. We…
